archiveTitle: Morning Brief | Take-Two Subpoenas Microsoft and Discord Over GTA VI Leak

entries.headline: Marvel’s Wolverine Goes Gold, Still Set for September 15
entries.summary: Insomniac Games announced that Marvel’s Wolverine has gone gold and showcased an in-game unlockable golden claw. The official X post was rate-limited during this round, so Gematsu’s article is retained and the fact status is marked as media reporting official information.
entries.verification: Gematsu article opened; the cited Insomniac official X page returned 403, primary source verification not completed.
entries.timeNote: Converted from Gematsu 11:00 EDT; exact time of official X post not directly verified

entries.headline: Take-Two Demands Microsoft and Discord Records in GTA VI Leak Probe
entries.summary: Take-Two filed a DMCA subpoena in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, seeking records from Microsoft and Discord by September 4 to identify accounts linked to the recent GTA VI asset leak. The subpoena document is dated August 20; this is a delayed catch-up entry and is not marked as official because the DocumentCloud original could not be opened directly.
entries.verification: Two outlets corroborate the subpoena targets, filing date, and September 4 deadline; DocumentCloud original returned 403. This is a catch-up item, not counted as a new event on August 20.
entries.timeNote: Converted from The Verge 16:52 UTC; court document only confirms August 20, exact time pending

entries.headline: The Duskbloods First Network Test Ends Early Due to Server Login Issues
entries.summary: Shortly after the first Switch 2 network test began, many participants could not log in. FromSoftware then ended the session early and said it would improve servers and announce further plans later. The official X statement could not be opened directly this round, so VGC and Game Informer reports are cross-verified.
entries.verification: Both outlets cite the same official statement; the official X post returned 403, primary source verification not completed.

entries.headline: Free Expansion 'Blood & Brine' Now Available for Tails of Iron II
entries.summary: The free expansion adds the new Hardshell Brook region, 11 quests, 10 boss fights, 9 armor sets, and 32 collectible aquatic creatures, plus crossover armor from indie games like Cult of the Lamb and Dave the Diver. PlayStation Blog and Xbox Wire have both been directly verified.
entries.verification: Both platform official announcements confirm the free release and core content; officials only list the date, no media time replaces official release time.
entries.timeNote: Media report time; official pages only list August 21, no exact time provided

mediaAlts.alt: Tails of Iron II: Whiskers of Winter: official key art for the free expansion 'Blood & Brine'

entries.headline: New Vampire Survivors DLC Set for August 28
entries.summary: The new expansion will add over 10 characters, more than 16 weapons and evolutions, an XL map, and 8 music tracks. The Steam DLC page has been checked for content overview but still only shows '2026'; the August 28 date comes from a poncle announcement cited by Gematsu, and the official video was inaccessible this round, so it is not marked as officially confirmed.
entries.verification: Steam supports the DLC's existence and content but does not show August 28; official YouTube link restricted, date treated as media-reported.

entries.headline: The Blood of Dawnwalker Console Graphics Modes Revealed
entries.summary: A five-minute showcase reveals that PS5 Pro, PS5, and Xbox Series X all offer a quality mode with dynamic 4K/30fps and a balanced mode with dynamic 4K/40fps; Xbox Series S specs have not been announced. The game's official website has been checked for platforms and the September 3 release date, but the primary X and YouTube pages for performance data could not be fully opened.
entries.verification: Official site confirms game, platforms, and date; two outlets cross-check performance data, official social posts not directly verified.

mediaAlts.alt: The Blood of Dawnwalker: official key art for the console graphics modes reveal

entries.headline: Shroom and Gloom Enters Steam Early Access on September 10
entries.summary: This first-person dual-deck-building roguelike will enter Steam Early Access on September 10; the current version plans two routes, each with about 300 exploration and combat cards, and Early Access is expected to last 12 to 24 months. The Steam store has been directly verified for date and version nature.
entries.verification: Steam confirms September 10, PC platform, and Early Access plan; Devolver news page returned 403.
entries.timeNote: Converted from Gematsu 12:05 EDT; Steam page does not provide update time

mediaAlts.alt: Shroom and Gloom: official key art for the September 10 Steam Early Access launch

entries.headline: Arknights: Endfield New Version Set for September 2
entries.summary: The new version will take players into a snow forest and looping time zone, adding new operators and a free obtainable character. The official preview program aired at 19:30 Beijing time on August 21, but official X and YouTube pages were restricted this round, so the September 2 date is treated as reported by Gematsu.
entries.verification: Official account identity and preview program time confirmed, but original posts returned 403 and video access was restricted; date not primary-verified.
entries.timeNote: Converted from Gematsu 08:00 EDT; official preview program started at 19:30 Beijing time

entries.headline: Nintendo DMCA Requests Take Down 401 Emulator Repositories
entries.summary: VGC, citing TorrentFreak, reports that seven DMCA requests from Nintendo targeted projects including Suyu, Skyline, and MonoNX, resulting in 401 GitHub repositories being removed, 311 of which were related to Suyu. The original GitHub DMCA notice could not be located and opened this round, so the numbers are not marked as official.
entries.verification: VGC article opened; no directly verifiable GitHub DMCA original notice found, media report status retained.

entries.headline: VHOLUME Launches on Steam (Catch-up)
entries.summary: The first-person parkour adventure VHOLUME is now on sale on Steam, with the store listing August 21 and Simplified Chinese support. Since the store does not show an exact unlock time, this is a catch-up entry based on our discovery time of 09:26 this round, not mixed with confirmed-time news.
entries.verification: Steam store opened and confirms availability, date, and language; 3DM used only as a discovery lead.
entries.timeNote: Our discovery time; Steam only lists August 21, exact unlock time pending

mediaAlts.alt: VHOLUME: official key art for the Steam full release (catch-up)

entries.headline: Warrior Spirits Planned for Steam Launch Today (Beijing Time)
entries.summary: Reignite Games' martial arts-themed turn-based card RPG is planned to unlock on August 22, featuring story, deck-building, roguelike runs, raid bosses, and online PvP. At the 10:10 verification, the store still showed about 8 hours until unlock, so the status is 'planned for release today', not 'already live'.
entries.verification: Steam opened and confirms August 22 and platform; store countdown shows unlock after this window.
entries.timeNote: Steam only lists the date; not unlocked as of 10:10

mediaAlts.alt: Warrior Spirits: official key art for the planned Steam launch today (Beijing time)

entries.headline: Mireglow Planned for Nintendo Switch Release Today
entries.summary: This combat-free, timer-free light exploration game set in a magical swamp is listed for digital release on August 22 on the North American Nintendo store. The store only provides the date; exact unlock time and other region availability are pending.
entries.verification: North American Nintendo product page opened and confirms date, platform, and release format.
entries.timeNote: North American Nintendo store only lists the date

mediaAlts.alt: Mireglow: official key art for the planned Nintendo Switch release today

entries.headline: Horror Prison: Escape Planned for Nintendo Switch Release Today
entries.summary: The first-person puzzle horror game Horror Prison: Escape is planned for digital release on August 22 on the North American Nintendo store, focusing on exploring and escaping an abandoned prison. Exact unlock time and other region dates have not been announced.
entries.verification: North American Nintendo product page opened and confirms date, platform, and release format.
entries.timeNote: North American Nintendo store only lists the date
